name.ja: セインティック・ピルグリム

effect.en: Add 1 "Lumina the Dimensional Sworn Ally", "Riel the Dimensional Sworn Ally", or "Saintick Crusade" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you shuffled a WIND Attribute monster by this effect, you can look at 1 face-down card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone. Then, if that card is a Trap Card, destroy it.
